probes.detail: Retry metadata write erased pending-upload status; local title changed, peer still sees Before after another round.
Reset during a round was followed by a successful upload; only the next round noticed reset.
Own shard disappeared but Sync reported success and sent zero files.
Decoder accepted numeric URL, out-of-range shard, and head timestamp beyond vv; round reported success but savedPage now throws.
Unsupported protocol file silently skipped; round reported clean success.
A valid attachment in the second files/ folder is invisible to storedFiles().
Folder consolidation recursively deleted a file uploaded after the child-list snapshot.
A durable dot at 100 followed by a post-crash dot at 50 loses the title on merge. Android persistence ordering was established by source inspection.
Waiting for removal review prevented an unrelated new browser save from reaching another device.
With request deadlines shortened to 5ms, a stalled body was still not aborted after 25ms because call() cleared the timer at headers.
